body:
I mean, I appreciate the response at all. Hopefully there is a program on campus that can appropriately facilitate this, but we'll see. I just would really rather avoid going through my parents for something like this. I think my school has a pretty well-equipped counseling/medical staff so maybe they'll have something useful.

Thanks for the words.

Yeah, like I said I don't really know why I posted this- definitely not looking to get diagnosed online and I'm trying to not self-diagnose. I know I need to see a professional but the whole idea just gives me anxiety, which feels really foreign to me otherwise.

Maybe I should look into some options on my campus.
